item.title: Strayed, A Rust-Inspired Multiplayer VR Survival Game, Gets Massive Update & Price Drop
item.description: Rust-inspired VR survival game Strayed gets massive update and a new (lower) price point on Quest and Steam.

item.title: Virtual Hunter PlayStation VR2 & Quest Ports Delayed To May
item.description: The PlayStation VR2 and Quest ports of Virtual Hunter have been pushed back two months.

item.title: Splatsplasm Impressions: A Fun But Uneven Swat-a-Thon
item.description: Splatsplasm is a frantic VR rhythm game that puts you in the role of an astronaut fending off flying aliens. We went hands-on with this fun, if uneven, space-based take on Beat Saber.

item.title: SteamVR Usage Significantly Fell February - But There's A Good Reason
item.description: The number of people using a VR headset on Steam ostensibly significantly decreased in February, according to Valve's data, but the figure isn't what it seems.

item.title: Final Fury Punches Up A Fresh Update Including A New Character
item.description: Final Fury's Sands of Ouroboros update adds a tactical zoner alongside a new mechanic for downed fighters to defend themselves.

item.title: Meta's FrameSync OS Upgrade Promises Visually Smoother VR On Quest
item.description: Meta is upgrading the frame timing algorithm of Horizon OS with an overhaul called FrameSync, and it should result in more consistently visually smooth VR with noticeably fewer hitches. Read the technical specifics here.

item.title: Thrill Of The Fight 2 VR Boxing Turned Into Live Spectator Event
item.description: At a recent Global Gaming League event, competitors threw punches in The Thrill of the Fight 2, turning the VR boxing game into a live, physical spectacle for a cheering audience.

item.title: Behind The Scenes of Walkabout Mini Golf's New Passport Hollywood Course
item.description: We toured Walkabout Mini Golf's new Passport Hollywood course and sat down with Mighty Coconut's Don Carson to discuss how it was made.

item.title: Orcs Must Die! By The Blade Review: Patched To Perfection?
item.description: Following a recent patch, Orcs Must Die! By the Blade has become a strong VR melee combat game with engaging light strategy elements.

item.title: Games Executive Jason Rubin Leaves Meta After 12 Years
item.description: Jason Rubin has left Meta after 12 years, having been VP of Content at Oculus, Facebook, and then Meta, with various official titles.
